title: Finite Boundary-Layer Residence Certificates for Non-Strict Control Barrier Functions
summary: Non-strict control barrier function (CBF) conditions guarantee safety through forward invariance, but they do not preclude trajectories from remaining near the safe-set boundary for extended continuous time intervals. This paper develops a finite boundary-layer residence certificate for such settings. The certificate preserves the standard non-strict CBF safety condition and uses a bounded auxiliary function whose derivative is bounded away from zero in a prescribed boundary layer, yielding an explicit upper bound on every uninterrupted residence interval.
